## Question 1
```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
summary(ny_noaa)
```
This data set has 7 variables and 2,595,176 rows of data. Key variables include, id, data, prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, and tmin. There are quite a lot of NA values, especially in the tmax and tmin variables. 

```{r}
# Data Cleaning and Converting Units
ny_noaa <- 
  ny_noaa |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    day = day(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10, 
    prcp = prcp / 10
  )
summary(ny_noaa)
```
prcp: Precipitation (tenths of mm)
snow: Snowfall (mm)
temp: (tenths of degrees C)

```{r}
ny_noaa |> 
  count(snow, sort = T)
```
For snowfall, the most commonly observed value is 0, because it doesn't snow most days of the year. 

```{r}
ny_noaa |> 
  filter(month == 1 | month == 7) |>      # Jan or July only
  group_by(id, year, month) |>      # per each station and year
  summarize(mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") |>     # dropping NA to remove clutter
  drop_na(mean_tmax) |> 
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = c(1, 7), labels = c("January", "July"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_tmax, group = id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(. ~ month) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean max temperature °C",
       title = "Average Max Temperature in January vs July, per station")+
  theme_minimal()
```
From these plots, we can see that the average max temperature in January is much lower compared to July. In January, the range is from about 10°C to as low as below -10°C. In July it is as hot as over 30°C to about 20°C, with an outlier of ~14°C.

```{r}
p1 <- ny_noaa |> 
  drop_na(tmax, tmin) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_hex() +
  labs(x = "tmin (°C)", y = "tmax (°C)", title = "tmax vs tmin") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ny_noaa |> 
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |> 
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = snow)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "year", y = "snowfall (mm)", title = "snowfall between 0 and 100 mm") +
  theme_minimal()

p1 + p2
```
